title: Multi-Player, cNFTcon, Supply Chains | Cornucopias
description:
Multi-Player functionality ahead of schedule, cNFTcon Demos and Sample Supply Chains! 

In this episode of COPI Cafe Josh and Rob announce some exciting new hires, answer questions from the community and discuss our COPI stake pool and possible scams. They also share exciting news about multi-player functionality, talk about what to expect in Las Vegas for cNFTcon and finish up on a discussion about the in-game supply chains. 

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw 

00:00 - Intro 
00:38 - Beverage Choices
02:43 - COPI Stake Pool Update
06:25 - Custom Dome Sale Recap
09:56 - Gameplay Content Discussion
11:24 - Land, Vehicle + Custom Dome Staking
13:13 - Mobile Game Update
14:50 -  cNFTcon - Las Vegas Plans
15:50 - Multi-Player in Cornucopias
17:00 - New Team Members
19:37 - Community Questions
26:14 - LEAK
34:10 - Focus on Building

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK 

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
